title.kicker: An adventure about the memory of Anceu
pause.title: Paused
ui.rotate: Rotate your phone for a better experience
pro.l1: There are places the world has forgotten.
pro.l2: Beneath this still water sleep roofs, paths and mills… and the voices of those who lived there.
pro.l3: Memories nobody keeps don't die. They turn into fog.
pro.l4: And tonight, the fog is hungry for memory.
a1.c1.l2: The house already smells of coffee.
a1.obj.rosa: Say good morning to Rosa in the kitchen
a1.obj.africa: Find África at the long table
a1.obj.door: Follow the paw print to the door
a1.rosa.1: Good morning, Pepe! Up already? You always know when something's on the stove.
a1.rosa.2: Hold on, the bread arrives at nine. Like always. Go on, say hello to África.
a1.agustin.1: Pepe! One-gig symmetric fibre and there you are, doing nothing. That's the spirit.
a1.agustin.2: No meetings until eleven today. That's proper rural hacking.
a1.africa.1: Hi, sweetheart. Have you seen the fog in the valley? You can't even see the reservoir.
a1.africa.2: My grandmother used to say the fog takes away the things nobody remembers… Bah, grandma stories.
a1.c2.l2: …where's the bread van? It's never late.
a1.c2.l3: The light in the window fades. The fog pours into the house like water.
a1.c2.l4: Pepe… what was I doing here? I… I can't remember.
a1.c2.l5: Listen: you know every corner of Anceu, every path, every neighbour.
a1.c2.l6: Go, Pepe. Find what has been lost.
a2.c1.l1: Anceu has fallen silent. No birds, no bells, no dogs.
a2.c1.l2: But down there, where the mills sleep, something still shines.
a2.obj.muinos: Follow the paw prints to the mills
muinos.c1.l1: The mills by the stream. They haven't ground in years.
muinos.c1.l2: A mother and a little girl, a sack of corn on their backs…
muinos.c1.l3: …a memory the fog has almost erased.
muinos.laurita.1: Oh, Pepe… is that you? What am I doing here? I haven't come to the mill since I was a little girl…
muinos.laurita.2: I used to come with my mother. She opened the channel and the water came singing down to the wheel. But I can't remember how…
muinos.laurita.3: If the mill could grind again… maybe I could remember again. Will you help me, dear?
muinos.hint.gate: The water was taken from further up the stream. There was a wooden gate…
muinos.hint.boulder: The channel is blocked. Get up on it where the wall is low, or climb!
muinos.hint.lever: At the end of the channel there's a lever. It let the water through to the wheel.
muinos.hint.door: Listen… it's grinding! Go in, Pepe, go in.
muinos.obj.boulder: Get up on the channel and move the rock blocking the water
muinos.obj.lever: Pull the lever at the end of the channel
muinos.c2.l1: The water flows… but something stops it halfway.
muinos.c3.l1: The wheel turns. After so many years, the mill breathes.
muinos.c3.l2: The mill door creaks ajar, like an invitation.
muinos.mem.l1: My mother poured the grain into the hopper and said: listen, Laurita, the stone is singing.
muinos.mem.l2: I'd push my hands into the warm flour. It smelled of bread before it was bread.
muinos.mem.l3: We came at night, when there was enough water, and slept here to the sound of the wheel.
muinos.mem.l4: Now I remember. I remember everything.
muinos.pegada.name: The Mills · Laurita's memory
muinos.end.1: Thank you, Pepe. I thought I'd forget my mother forever.
muinos.end.2: The fog still covers the village. There are more lost memories: the three-village football match, Monte de Toro… and Eiras, under the water.
muinos.end.3: Go on, dear. As long as someone remembers, Anceu lives.
obj.after_muinos: Head back home. Other memories are waiting
end.l1: One memory recovered. Around the mill, Anceu has its colour back.
end.l2: But four memories remain in the fog… and at the bottom of the reservoir, Eiras waits.
end.l3: As long as someone remembers, the village lives.
end.title: To be continued…
